edges.effect_quant: A small and mixed literature point in more than one direction, so no single pooled effect estimate is reliable enough to summarize cleanly.
edges.mechanism: The main pathway runs through circadian timing, arousal biology, upper-airway physiology, thermoregulation, or sympathetic activation depending on the exposure. For Sleep maintenance, the effect is usually strongest when the factor repeatedly disturbs sleep architecture or circadian alignment rather than acting once.
edges.summary: Standard-dose melatonin appears tied to mixed effects on sleep maintenance in adults with insomnia mainly through a small and mixed literature. The likely magnitude is modest, which is why the edge is framed conservatively rather than as a headline-level breakthrough.
edges.caveats: Dose, timing, and baseline risk still matter. Observational edges may partly reflect broader lifestyle patterning, while small trials can overstate benefit if follow-up is short.
